title: SkyraIngestionBatchRequestV1
description: Authoritative and backward-compatible batch request envelope for Skyra LogHub Ingestion Gateway v1.

oneOf.title: AuthoritativeV1Batch
oneOf.description: Standard authoritative v1 ingestion envelope including explicit protocol version and idempotent batch UUID.

protocol_version.description: Contract protocol version. Must be '1.0' for v1 gateway.

batch_id.description: Client-generated RFC 4122 UUIDv4 idempotency key. Identical batch_id on retry must match payload hash.

sent_at.description: Client transmission timestamp in RFC3339 UTC format ending with Z.

batch_size.description: Declared number of events in the batch. Must match events.length.

events.description: Array of canonical Skyra log events conforming to ECS 8.11.0 and Skyra Log Event Schema v1.

oneOf.title: LegacyV1Batch
oneOf.description: Backward-compatible legacy browser SDK batch envelope without protocol_version or batch_id.

sent_at.description: Client transmission timestamp in RFC3339 UTC format ending with Z.

batch_size.description: Declared number of events in the batch. Must match events.length.

events.description: Array of canonical Skyra log events conforming to ECS 8.11.0 and Skyra Log Event Schema v1.
